run_video_demo: run the VGGSfM video demo on a scene directory with sequential input images
create_video_runner: create a VideoRunner instance to process sequential image inputs for structure-from-motion
load_demo_dataset: load a demo dataset from a scene directory with configurable image size and ground truth loading
seed_random_engines: seed all random number generators for reproducible VGGSfM inference results
run_vggsfm_inference: run VGGSfM inference on image batches with masks, crop params, and bundle adjustment intervals
